Armitage and other house searches not run. Gowans own results are the best same-buyer-pool evidence (35 myrtle slab sales since Feb 2026, median $45, high $180 for two). eBay sold would add little.
viewing_check: Measure thickness and width, and length. Check for end checks, splits, spalting or insect holes, and whether it is dry (stacked and aged) or green. Confirm species (pink/red myrtle, not sassafras or blackwood). A wide, thick, clean slab is the top end of the Gowans range (about $110 to $125 hammer); thin or split ones sell $15 to $60.
